name: SM-05: The visibility chosen when scheduling is kept

steps.name: Discoverable session still reads Discoverable in its edit form
The group room tab bar should render — if it does not, this member has no access to the group getByRole('tab', { name: 'Settings', exact: true })
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: /Schedule a Session/i })
Scroll into view getByRole('button', { name: /Schedule a Session/i })
Wait for selector getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })

Wait for selector getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })).first().locator('[role="heading"], h2, p').filter({ hasText: /schedule a session/i }).first()

Click locator('[role="dialog"][aria-label="Select Tags"]').locator('input[type="checkbox"], label, button').filter({ hasNot: locator('input[name="isPrivateSession"]') }).filter({ hasNot: getByRole('button', { name: /close/i }) }).first()

Check getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })).first().getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Who can see this session?' }).getByRole('radio', { name: 'Discoverable', exact: true })

Expect "toBeChecked" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })).first().getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Who can see this session?' }).getByRole('radio', { name: 'Discoverable', exact: true })
Wait for selector getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })).first().getByRole('button', { name: /Schedule.*(Now|Session)/i })
Scroll into view getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })).first().getByRole('button', { name: /Schedule.*(Now|Session)/i })

Expect "toBeHidden" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })).first().locator('[role="heading"], h2, p').filter({ hasText: /schedule a session/i }).first()
Session "PW_Session_20261016_152813_w0r0179axj" should be listed before opening it getByTestId('group-session-card').filter({ hasText: 'PW_Session_20261016_152813_w0r0179axj' }).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit session', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })).first().getByText('Edit session', { exact: true })

Expect "toBeChecked" getByTestId('create-session-modal').or(getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Schedule Session' })).first().getByRole('radiogroup', { name: 'Who can see this session?' }).getByRole('radio', { name: 'Discoverable', exact: true })
